subject: Candlelight Networks onboarding — waterfall token routing & category split
messages:

Subject: Candlelight Networks onboarding — PO coverage and spend allocation

Hi Vanessa / Monica,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. To move forward with vendor activation we need a formal PO number and an initial spend allocation. A couple of practical questions so we can line up our billing: 

- Will Redwood issue a single master PO with sub-references (waterfall tokens) for discrete line allocations (compute / support / services)?
- Is the spend cap enforced at the master PO level or per sub-ref? For our pilot we anticipate a burst pattern — want to avoid hitting a hard block mid-month.

I'm attaching our completed onboarding form and a sample invoice so your team can map SKUs. Also included our procurement contact in cc.

Attachments: candlelight_onboarding_form.pdf (onboarding form), vendor_invoice_sample.pdf (sample invoice)

Next action: if you can confirm the PO pattern and initial spend cap we can return the signed materials.

Best,
Ari Kaplan
Head of Finance, Candlelight Networks
ari@candlelight.ai
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candlelight Networks onboarding — PO coverage and spend allocation

Hi Ari — thanks for sending the form and invoice sample. Quick answers below and a proposed next step.

- We typically issue a master PO (PURR-98321) and create sub-refs (tokenized purchase refs) that map to line allocations. Sub-refs allow us to track line-level consumption and do targeted corrections without reissuing the master PO.
- The spend cap is enforced at the master PO level by default. However, for pilots we can temporarily bump the effective cap for a single month (subject to procurement sign-off) and still keep the master PO as the controlling object.

Proposed mapping (please confirm):
- Compute: SUB-COMP-98321 (SKU map: CL-COMP-*)
- Support (SLA/uptime): SUB-SUP-98321 (SKU map: CL-SUP-*)
- Professional Services: SUB-PS-98321 (SKU map: CL-PS-*)

I've attached our PO template CSV for your finance team to populate preferred line descriptions and SKU codes. Once we have the populated template and the signed onboarding form we can issue PURR-98321 as a provisional PO and generate the sub-refs.

Action items for Candlelight: populate po_template.csv with line descriptions + desired initial token allocations; confirm whether you need a temporary uplift for the pilot month.

Attachments: po_template.csv

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Vendor Enablement Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Candlelight Networks onboarding — PO coverage and spend allocation

Thanks Vanessa — that pattern works. A couple follow-ups from our side: 

1) Waterfall behavior: when a sub-ref consumes its allocation, does the platform automatically debit from the master PO remaining balance or do you require a manual reconciliation? We want to know how close we can push a sub-ref before the master cap prevents fulfillment.

2) Line-item corrections: occasionally we mis-code an invoice line and need a backdated correction. What's the preferred flow for submitting corrections so finance can reassign spend to the intended sub-ref?

We filled the CSV with preliminary numbers and attached a signed copy of the onboarding form (see onboarding_form_signed.pdf). For the pilot we would like a one-month uplift to $150,000 (from the proposed $120,000) to accommodate initial experimentation. Can you advise the fastest path to get procurement approval for a one-month uplift?

Attachments: onboarding_form_signed.pdf, vendor_invoice_sample.pdf

— Ari
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari@candlelight.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 12:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candlelight Networks onboarding — PO coverage and spend allocation

Hi Ari — welcome aboard. Short answers below plus the formal references we'll issue.

- Waterfall behavior: Consumption is deducted from the master PO balance automatically; sub-refs are accounting slices. If a sub-ref approaches its allocated token, the system will attempt to draw from the master PO remaining dollars. If the master PO balance is exhausted, requests will fail per SLO safeguards — which is why we recommend the temporary uplift for pilots.

- Line-item corrections: submit a correction request via our procurement portal (use the HubSpot/Drive link below) and include: original invoice ID, erroneous line SKU, corrected SKU, and the desired sub-ref target. Procurement will issue a retrospective reallocation and update ledger entries; corrections are visible in the PO history. Small corrections (<$2k) are typically handled without a formal credit memo; larger adjustments may require an amended invoice.

I'll issue the master provisional PO as PURR-98321 and create the three sub-refs once we receive the signed form and the populated template. To expedite the one-month uplift to $150k: please confirm in-writing (reply to this thread) that the uplift is for the pilot month only and we'll open a procurement fast-track. Final approval generally requires PO owner + finance reviewer sign-off; I'll take point on the procurement side.
